summary: MTN VIBEZ is DJ Mtn Vibez, run by Guillermo Moreno, who spins a weekly Latin Night at One World Brewing West every Wednesday (dance lesson 8:30-9pm, open dance 9pm-midnight, $10 cover) and also plays a Saturday 'Miami Nights' Latin set at Hemingway's Cuba. It is a paid, DJ-hosted brewery party open to the public, not a membership community; the attendees are a rotating crowd of dancers and nightlife patrons, while only the DJ/host is the constant.

evidence.note: Listing text is purely promotional/instructional ('MTN VIBEZ Presents Latin Night every Wednesday... $10 cover'), with no membership, dues, or 'our group' language across any of the 6 units.
One crossover listing pairs 'DJ Mtn Vibez & Las Montañitas', but Las Montañitas is a separate Chicha-Cumbia band/performance act, not part of the recurring Wednesday night's identity.

Web search confirms DJ Mtn Vibez (Guillermo Moreno) is the organizer/performer of Latin Night Wednesday at One World Brewing West and also runs a separate Saturday 'Miami Nights' Latin set at Hemingway's Cuba, i.e. a touring DJ brand, not a bounded group of regulars.
A same-named 'Mountain Vibez Productions' wedding/event DJ company also exists in Asheville; unclear if related, but either way it is a commercial DJ operation, not a social club.

The same weekly Wednesday slot is scraped by 4 different sources under 4 slightly different titles/organizers (MTN VIBEZ, One World Brewing - West, One World Brewing West), consistent with a venue-hosted recurring party rather than a distinct organized group with its own identity.
